content: Statins (HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors) directly inhibit hepatic HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme in cholesterol biosynthesis. Reduced cholesterol synthesis downregulates the LDL receptor due to decreased intracellular cholesterol levels. This leads to diminished LDL receptor-mediated clearance of circulating LDL, thereby elevating LDL cholesterol levels.
